String with the text of credits line slot 19: the credits scripts set it when a line starts in slot 19 (e.g. global/script_0454.scumm with "/EC__110/THE END"), and rooms/093_endcred/local_2005.scumm:253 draws it with 'blast-text ... "%s{var683}"' while the slot scrolls.

684.Note: Unconfirmed: room 93 (end credits). Set to 1 when a credits line scrolls off the top (rooms/093_endcred/local_2005.scumm:14-15) and never cleared or read by any script, so perhaps a leftover 'a line has finished' flag.

685.Name: credits-lead-line
685.Note: Room 93 (end credits). The slot (1-19) of the line at the head of the scroll, the one that moves without waiting. Starts at 1 (rooms/093_endcred/local_2005.scumm:4), and moves to the next slot, wrapping after 19, each time a line scrolls off (rooms/093_endcred/local_2005.scumm:19-22). rooms/093_endcred/local_2007.scumm:4-6 lets that slot always move; any other slot (context, not mentioning var685) waits until the slot before it has risen 30 (rooms/093_endcred/local_2007.scumm:8-16).

686.Name: banjo-note-index
686.Note: Room 25 (banjo duel). Which note of the tune is being played or answered: global/script_0217.scumm:11 resets it to 0 and global/script_0217.scumm:69 adds 1 after each opponent note; each of Guybrush's string clicks adds 1 too (rooms/025_banjo/local_2011.scumm:7-9). global/script_0216.scumm:28-30 waits for the player's turn to end with 'while (var686 <= var428)'. Indexes banjo-played-strings and banjo-riff-sounds (rooms/025_banjo/local_2009.scumm:49).

687.Name: banjo-max-tune-length
687.Note: Room 25 (banjo duel). Length of the final round's tune: 4 when bit65 is set, else 5 (global/script_0216.scumm:7-13). global/script_0216.scumm:15 ends the duel after that round; rooms/025_banjo/local_2004.scumm:5 picks notes up to it and gives the last note of the final round sound 446 (rooms/025_banjo/local_2004.scumm:19-20).

688.Name: banjo-answer-time
688.Note: Room 25 (banjo duel). How many frames Guybrush has to play the tune back: 75 when bit65 is set, else 60 (global/script_0216.scumm:7-12). rooms/025_banjo/local_2013.scumm:4-8 counts frames up to it, then starts script 213.

689.Note: Unconfirmed: room 25 (banjo duel). Set to 5 before the opponent plays (global/script_0216.scumm:14, global/script_0217.scumm:12) and to 1 once Guybrush's turn starts (global/script_0216.scumm:24). Its only read is global/script_0217.scumm:4-8, which re-enters room 25 in a cut-scene unless it is 5, so it may mean 'already in the duel view'. I couldn't tell why the values are 1 and 5.
